items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: He was more like Isham Jones. You know Isham Jones wasn't no help. He was just a big performer... But he had a hell of a band.

ctx.x: I thought that was a cooperation band.

It was a cooperation band. So what they did, they hired a leader... They just hired a guy to get up there and beat. And we had one guy who was like a performer. He was more like Isham Jones. You know Isham Jones wasn't no help. He was just a big performer... But he had a hell of a band. So this guy, Lockwood, was our last leader before Cab come. So we ...(? )...(? )...

And we got involved with the Savoy. The Missourians could cut any band that played in the Savoy. I don't care who they was. You could bring them White bands in there, the big bands; by the time they got through playing their little Jazz, they was the favorite. So we were the favorite before Cab come with us.
